expectation: Membrane ring on FDC networks and mature B cells, clustered in lymphoid follicles, as a distinct minority of cells; plasma cells and GC B cells low. Not epithelium, muscle or stroma.
observed: A: the whole section glows yellow, brightest in muscle and mucosal epithelium, following tissue outline and density. B/D: saturated, uniform haze with no discrete cells. C: diffuse epithelial lining glow, no ring-like cells. E: broad blobs and haze, not tied to CD19 cells.
why: Diffuse tissue-following haze, no discrete membrane-stained subset or follicular network, and the CD19 overlap is not cell-specific.
notes: CD21 is a broad haze that follows tissue type (muscle, epithelium) and density. There are no distinct membrane-stained cells or follicle networks, and in E the signal does not sit on CD19 cells.
